prompt: A fish tank is $60$ cm long, $30$ cm wide, and $40$ cm tall. What is its volume in cubic centimeters?

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: A $6 \times 3 \times 4$ box has volume $72$. Your tank is $10\times$ bigger in every direction.

alternativeExplanations.title: Scale up a small box
steps: Each edge is $10\times$ longer, so the volume is $10 \times 10 \times 10 = 1000\times$ bigger: $72 \times 1000 = 72{,}000$.
